AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming cleaning? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming cleaning.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming cleaning.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming cleaning.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming cleaning.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)

   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Removal 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Croc? (1 mark)

   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously

18. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

19. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

20. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundry: Stain Removal? (1 mark)
